hooks.name: Engine and AI rules: run safety tests
hooks.description: When a decision-engine or AI-grounding file is saved, run the engine property tests and the explainer guard tests (not the whole suite, so it stays fast).

action.command: cd "$(dirname "$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name vitest.config.ts -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -print -quit)")" && npx vitest run tests/engine tests/api/journey-intelligence.test.ts
